run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T01:45:48Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by errors originating in the otel-demo ad service. frontend-proxy's own ingress and router-frontend-egress spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR from about 01:52 onward (peak ~1.00 errors/s at 02:00:48), while total span rate stayed ~10-13/s; the errors appear on the frontend->ad path (frontend client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, frontend route GET /api/data) and on ad's own server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (0.40-0.99 errors/s, 01:54:48-02:04:48). Chaos Mesh events show a Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-return in namespace chaos-mesh spawning a JVMChaos experiment every minute from 01:51:27 to 02:00:27; each spawned JVMChaos Starts/Applies to pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-sk6fg (container ad), times out after ~50s and is Recovered, and the ad GetAds error rate pulses (1.3-2.0/s per-minute rate) inside exactly those applied windows. The ad pod logged gRPC 'Exception while executing runnable ...HalfClosed' lines during the fault and runs with restarts 0 (never restarted), so this is injected method-level JVM chaos on ad, not a crash, eviction, restart or resource shortfall. adHighCpu/adManualGc-style effects are not supported: ad JVM CPU stayed at 0.46-0.70 (vs ~0.29 before) with no saturation. Verified-healthy: accounting and payment error spans stayed 0 across the window; recommendation and fraud-detection show only a steady ~0.0037/s background on flagd EventStream spans both before and during. The stated alert value (2.111 at 01:45:48) does not match the sampled metrics: at 01:45:48 frontend-proxy error rate was 0 and errors begin ~01:51:37, and no RequestErrorRate rule was found, so the alert's exact expression/series remains unconfirmed.

claims.text: frontend-proxy span_name=ingress and span_name=router frontend egress carried status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR from the 01:52:48 sample (0.178 and 0.159 errors/s) up to peaks of 1.004 and 0.985 errors/s at 02:00:48, vs a ~0.007-0.015 errors/s baseline at 01:28:48-01:50:48, while the STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate of the same span names stayed ~10-13/s.

At 02:05:00 the only non-zero error-span rates were ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 0.389, frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and GET /api/data 0.380, frontend GET 0.380 and GET /api/data 0.380, and frontend-proxy router frontend egress 0.389 / ingress 0.402; cart, checkout, payment, accounting and recommendation error rates were 0 in that instant.

ad service span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds has ERROR status only from the 01:54:48 sample onward (0.399 at 01:54:48, 0.583 at 01:56:48, 0.721 at 01:58:48, 0.985 at 02:00:48, 0.790 at 02:02:48, 0.429 at 02:04:48); status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for that operation do not appear at earlier sample times, and ad's flagd ResolveBoolean/EventStream error rates stayed 0-0.004/s.

A 1-minute rate of ad GetAds ERROR spans shows discrete pulses rather than a sustained rise: 1.73 at 01:54:00, 1.37 at 01:56:00, 1.67 at 01:59:00, 2.00 at 02:00:00, 1.70 at 02:01:00 and 1.27 at 02:02:00, with 0 at the interleaved 30-second points.

Service-level ERROR span rate rose only for frontend-proxy (0.014 at 01:50:48 -> 1.341 at 01:55:48 -> 1.989 at 02:00:48 -> 0.599 at 02:05:48), frontend (2.607 at 01:55:48, 3.926 at 02:00:48) and ad (0.530 at 01:55:48, 0.985 at 02:00:48), while accounting and payment were 0 at every sample and recommendation/fraud-detection stayed at 0-0.0037/s both before and during the incident.

Chaos Mesh events show Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-return (namespace chaos-mesh) issuing 'Create new object: otel-demo-ad-jvm-return-<id>' (reason Spawned) once per minute at 01:51:27, 01:52:27, 01:53:27, 01:54:27, 01:55:27, 01:56:27, 01:57:27, 01:58:27, 01:59:27 and 02:00:27.

Each spawned JVMChaos object (for example otel-demo-ad-jvm-return-gbjlm at 01:51:27, -ljkwf at 01:55:27, -gzz89 at 01:59:27, -2xnmj at 02:00:27) recorded Started followed by 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-sk6fg/ad' about 2-10s later, then 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-sk6fg/ad' roughly 55s after the apply.

The ad pod's application log (container ad, pod ad-554b849958-sk6fg) contains repeated gRPC server-side failures, e.g. 'Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@...' at 01:55:32-01:55:59 and 01:59:34-02:00:42.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running with restartCount 0; ad-554b849958-sk6fg started at 2026-11-18T01:15:32Z on node i-00919402a8ea35027 and has no previous container instance, so no restart or crash of ad coincides with the errors.

The event groups returned for the window contain no event whose involvedObject is in namespace otel-demo; the fault-related groups are JVMChaos (chaos-mesh: Applied 9, Recovered 9, Started 10, TimeUp 9, Updated 55) and Schedule (chaos-mesh: Spawned 10, Updated 10), plus unrelated data-recorders namespace job/PVC/pod events.

ConfigMap flagd-config in namespace otel-demo holds demo.flagd.json, in which every fault flag including adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, paymentFailure and productCatalogFailure has defaultVariant "off" and state ENABLED at the time it was read (about 02:10).
ad's JVM CPU utilization ratio (label exported_job="opentelemetry-demo/ad") was 0.24-0.42 from 01:29:48 to 01:51:48 and only 0.46-0.70 from 01:53:48 onward, never approaching saturation.

The available metric-name list for this target contains 63 names and includes traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket but no http_server_request_duration_seconds* or rpc_client/rpc_server_duration_milliseconds* series.

At 01:45:48 (the alert's start time) frontend-proxy span error rate was 0 for both ingress and router frontend egress, with only 10.5/s UNSET spans, so the sampled metrics do not show elevated frontend-proxy errors at the instant the alert started.

A flag-based ad fault is not supported as the cause: adFailure is "off" in flagd-config when read, and the ad GetAds error rate pulses in separate ~50s windows matching the JVMChaos apply/recover cycle rather than staying continuously elevated as an enabled flag would.

adHighCpu / adManualGc-type JVM resource faults were considered and rejected as the cause of the errors: ad JVM CPU never exceeded 0.70 utilization and the failures are gRPC errors, not a latency-only degradation.

The ad pod's application-level gRPC failures ('Exception while executing runnable ...HalfClosed') are the mechanism by which the JVMChaos experiments (action name pattern 'jvm-return') force GetAds to fail, which frontend surfaces as grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds / GET /api/data errors and frontend-proxy surfaces as ingress/egress 5xx-equivalent error spans; this causal step is inferred from timing alignment, not from the unreadable experiment spec.

Stop or suspend the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-return (namespace chaos-mesh) so no further JVMChaos experiments are spawned against otel-demo/ad-554b849958-sk6fg, then confirm the ad GetAds ERROR span rate and frontend-proxy ingress/egress ERROR rate fall back to the ~0.01/s baseline.

gaps: The JVMChaos experiment spec (action, target class/method, injected return value or exception) could not be read: JVMChaos is not among the readable Kubernetes kinds, and customresourcedefinitions queries exceeded the 2 MiB result limit (RESULT_TOO_LARGE, no preserved result).

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule could not be located: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned nothing (no_data), so the alert's exact PromQL expression and series are unknown, as is the source of the annotated value 2.111 at 01:45:48; sampled frontend-proxy span error rate was 0 at 01:45:48 and only began rising at ~01:51:37-01:52:48.

No http_server_request_duration_seconds* or rpc_client/rpc_server_duration_milliseconds* series exist in this target's metric list, so a proxy-level counter that could carry the alert's value could not be checked.

The pod log streams for frontend-675fd7b5c5-zsgq9 (containers: frontend) and flagd-5667b74b84-vlt8x (containers init-config, flagd, flagd-ui) returned 0 lines read for 01:50-02:05 and 01:45-02:05 respectively, so the frontend and flagd application logs were not checked.

ad pod log evidence is limited: only the newest 25/60 matching lines of larger matching sets were returned (200 matching lines in 01:49-01:56, 453 in 01:45-02:09), so the exact first exception line and the total count of failing requests are unknown.

Event coverage for the Schedule and JVMChaos objects begins at 01:51:27; whether these experiments existed or ran, or whether any other chaos experiment ran, before that time in the authorized window is unknown.
The change_history integration is not available, so who or what created or last modified the Schedule/JVMChaos objects and when cannot be verified.
